description: Writes a session handoff when about 5 minutes of the 1h prompt cache remain on an idle session, then, once that cache has gone cold, opens a new conversation from the handoff or pins a notice.
name: cache-handoff

coldAction.description: new: clear to a new conversation opened by the handoff, named after the old one plus the date and time. notice: pin a reminder under the prompt. off: do nothing.
coldAction.title: When the cache goes cold
